top_critical.title: North Korea Hijacked npm debug & chalk Packages
top_critical.summary: North Korean threat actor Sapphire Sleet has been attributed by Amazon to the September 2025 hijacking of the widely used npm packages debug and chalk, which together account for over 2 billion weekly
top_critical.architects_take: Audit your dependency trees immediately for any packages that pulled updates to debug or chalk between September 2025 and the point of remediation, and review build pipeline artefact integrity. Enforce npm provenance attestation and consider pinning critical transitive dependencies to verified digests rather than version ranges.
